submitted_root_cause: Checkoutservice is configured to connect to emailservice on port 5999 via EMAIL_SERVICE_ADDR env var, but emailservice actually exposes ports 5000 and 8080, causing connection timeouts when trying to send order confirmation emails
submitted_action: Correct the EMAIL_SERVICE_ADDR environment variable from emailservice:5999 to emailservice:5000 to match the actual service port, then rollback the deployment to apply the configuration change
